prompt: We sell commercial funding and bookkeeping services. Build an end-to-end GTM target list for small businesses needing capital in the United States. First clarify the offer and ICP, then find ranked companies, identify the best CEO, CFO, Controller contacts, include intent or timing evidence where available, and return: company_name, domain, fit_score, fit_reason, contact_name, title, persona_fit_reason, linkedin_url, email_status, evidence_source, intent_signal, activation_recommendation, compliance_flags.
expected_output_schema: Create offer.md, icp.md, and a CSV-compatible lead list with contact-level rows.
